title: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan: Other Discounts, Protection Fees, AutoPay and Late Fees
content:
Under each Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan the plan settles whether the military discount and the move-in discount also apply to the prepaid months, whether tenant protection fees are part of the prepayment, whether AutoPay drafts pause while the term covers the agreement, and whether late fees can arise on rent during the term.

| Plan | Military discount also applies to the prepaid months | Move-in discount also applies | Tenant protection fees included in the prepayment | AutoPay drafts pause during the term | Late fees can arise on rent during the term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 3-Month Plan | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 6-Month Plan | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 9-Month Plan | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 12-Month Plan | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 18-Month Plan | No | No | No | Yes | No |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 24-Month Plan | No | No | No | Yes | No |

## Basis questions and answers

**Does the military discount on a covered agreement also reduce the prepaid months?**
Under the 3-, 6-, 9- and 12-month plans, yes. Under the 18- and 24-month plans, no.

**Does a move-in discount combine with any prepaid plan?**
No. Under all six plans the move-in discount does not also apply.

**Is the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan fee for the unit paid out of the prepayment?**
No. Under all six plans tenant protection fees are not included in the prepayment; they are billed separately.

**What happens to AutoPay on the covered agreement while the term runs?**
Under all six plans the AutoPay drafts pause while the term covers the agreement.

**Can a late fee arise on the rent of a covered agreement during the term?**
Under all six plans, no: late fees cannot arise on rent during the term.

## Hypothetical combinations

| Covered agreement carries | Plan bought | Military discount on prepaid months | Move-in discount on prepaid months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Military discount | 6-Month | Applies | – |
| Military discount | 24-Month | Does not apply | – |
| Move-in discount | 3-Month | – | Does not apply |
| Military and move-in discount | 12-Month | Applies | Does not apply |
